newsitem.title: USA: Micronics in merger talks with Hayes Micro.
newsitem.headline: Micronics in merger talks with Hayes Micro.

text.p: Micronics Computers Inc. said Friday it is in talks with Hayes Microcomputer Products Inc., a privately held company, concerning a potential stock-for-stock merger.
Micronics, which makes system boards for personal computers, said it was making the announcement following unusual trading volume in its stock, whose price has soared recently.
The Fremont, Calif.-based company had previously said it had hired a financial adviser to identify acquisition and strategic partner relationships.
The parties have not entered into any letter of intent or binding agreement and the outcome of any discussions with Hayes is uncertain at this time, Micronics said.
Micronics' stock was unchanged at $3.563 early on Nasdaq.
